title: Amrita Pritam's birth chart
metaDescription: Amrita Pritam's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 6.8° Virgo. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Four of the ten placements whose signs are settled stand in Leo — Mercury, Mars, Jupiter and Neptune. The placements whose signs could change with an unknown hour are not counted. A cluster that size becomes the section the rest of the chart plays around.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's position resolves to 6.8° Virgo — deep enough in the first decan (0°–10°) that Mercury, its traditional sub-ruler, colours the reading.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: Mercury holds 18.8° Leo, Venus holds 25.9° Virgo, Mars holds 5.1° Leo — in the old shorthand, thought that arrives already in motion; attraction that grows by reliability; effort spent in bursts and openings.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The tightest geometry in the chart puts the Sun a sixth of the circle apart from Pluto, 0.7° off exact. A sixth of the circle is close enough for cooperation and far enough that it stays optional. Behind it, Mars conjunction Jupiter at 1.1°, and Saturn opposition Uranus at 2.9° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: Mercury makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The dignity table, which predates the outer planets and only ever spoke for seven, marks two placements here. The Moon in Scorpio at 11.6° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Venus in Virgo at 25.9° is in fall. None of this ranks anyone; dignity describes footing, and footing can be worked with.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Tallied where the signs are certain — 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day — the chart gives fire 4, earth 3, water 2, air 1, and fixed 6, mutable 3, cardinal 1 across the modes. Venus and Uranus were retrograde — the backward drift a body appears to make as the Earth overtakes it, read in the scheme as a function that reviews before it releases.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Scorpio for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 11.9° between midnight and midnight. Whatever the unrecorded hour was, it happened inside one Moon sign — the degree floats, the sign holds. At the noon reference it stands at 11.6°.
